message: diffie-hellman-group14-sha1 builds its exchange hash with SHA-1, which has known collision attacks.
ssh-rsa signs with SHA-1, so OpenSSH turned it off by default in version 8.8.
aes128-cbc with a MAC over the plain text has a published plaintext recovery attack (Albrecht, Paterson and Watson, 2009).
